CREATE TEMP TABLE candle_winners ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_id,symbol,ts_open) * FROM candle_stage ORDER BY market_id,symbol,ts_open,ingested_at DESC,payload_order DESC

SELECT DISTINCT s.market_id,s.symbol FROM candle_winners s
            LEFT JOIN market_data.canonical_candles_1m c USING (market_id,symbol,ts_open)
            WHERE (c.ts_open IS NULL OR (s.ingested_at,s.payload_order) >
                   (c.ingested_at,c.payload_order)) AND
              (c.ts_open IS NULL OR ROW(s.instrument_key,s.ts_close,s.open,s.high,s.low,s.close,
                 s.volume_base,s.volume_quote,s.trades_count,s.taker_buy_volume_base,
                 s.taker_buy_volume_quote) IS DISTINCT FROM
               ROW(c.instrument_key,c.ts_close,c.open,c.high,c.low,c.close,c.volume_base,
                   c.volume_quote,c.trades_count,c.taker_buy_volume_base,c.taker_buy_volume_quote))

SELECT market_id,symbol,ts_open::date,
                bit_or(set_bit(0::bit(1440),
                    (extract(hour FROM ts_open)*60+extract(minute FROM ts_open))::int,1)),
                min(ts_open),max(ts_open)
            FROM candle_winners GROUP BY market_id,symbol,ts_open::date
            ORDER BY market_id,symbol,ts_open::date
INSERT INTO market_data.candle_coverage_days (market_id,symbol,day,generation,policy_version) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SELECT actual_count FROM market_data.candle_coverage_days WHERE market_id=%s AND symbol=%s AND day=%s FOR UPDATE
UPDATE market_data.candle_coverage_days SET actual=actual | %s::bit(1440), source_absent=source_absent & ~%s::bit(1440) WHERE market_id=%s AND symbol=%s AND day=%s RETURNING actual_count

INSERT INTO market_data.candle_coverage_summary AS s
                (market_id,symbol,generation,actual_count,first_ts,last_ts)
                VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT (market_id,symbol) DO UPDATE SET
                actual_count=s.actual_count+%s,
                first_ts=least(s.first_ts,EXCLUDED.first_ts),
                last_ts=greatest(s.last_ts,EXCLUDED.last_ts)

DELETE FROM market_data.source_absent_candles_1m a
            USING candle_winners s WHERE a.market_id=s.market_id AND a.symbol=s.symbol
            AND a.minute_key=extract(epoch FROM s.ts_open)::bigint/60
UPDATE market_data.instrument_generations SET content_revision=content_revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE market_id=%s AND symbol=%s
DELETE FROM market_data.candle_history_verification WHERE market_id=%s AND symbol=%s
UPDATE market_data.instrument_generations SET index_state='ready' WHERE market_id=%s AND symbol=%s
